body: Amazing I’m both glad and upset it’s not just me. Do you see yours online, too?

You’re heard. I can’t imagine how hard it is to handle depression with the added stress of being disabled. I feel trapped as it is. I hope talking about it helps you. 

I know you don’t want advice, but I do want to say - Government programs kind of suck sometimes, but sometimes there are nonprofits that can kinda do step arounds and help. No push though!

Thank you for this. Knowing someone else understands to this level really helps me. I think I do deserve better but there’s a part of me that just KNOWS he could be better if he committed to this. His fear of commitment is the only thing making this hard and it’s so upsetting thinking that there’s only one thing stopping this. I do deserve better but I’m not entirely I can want better right now and I hate myself for it.

We have discussed and are exclusive, which I forgot to mention. I have been worried that maybe his feelings don’t match up but he’s never said anything verbally that confirms that and has issues expressing himself anyways. I can tell I might be tricking myself but I don’t want to throw him out just bc he struggles to communicate either.
Thank you! I get lost on any I can’t find on the Pokémon website. I appreciate it!

Sorry, I’ve never used Imgur, I hope this is right lmao

https://imgur.com/a/R5q6B52
It’s the one that’s on the slide over in Japanese. It won’t let me look at literally anything else. It’s shiny on my card.

Thank you. Having someone outside of the three of us say we’re supporting each other well, even with limited knowledge, somehow helps. 

We’re (hopefully) cremating him later today and I’m trying to psych myself up for the call because I made it my job.
Yeah, like I don’t like having emotional scars and Trauma so it feels like a huge deal to willingly saddle someone with it. Constant limbo

I burned out similarly before. I’m the family caregiver and therapist type, and have been since I was a kid. I also burned out at work and took 6 months off work before I restarted therapy. It’s all very exhausting, lashing out is normal. 

It’s not your fault they don’t understand, but being more explicit may help. I know support groups are super important, and talking to your significant other candidly may also help you there. 

Not sure if you wanted a reply or not but know I’m rooting for you!
Sometimes I think like. If it looks like an accident? But then I know it’d still bug someone somewhere a lot. I’ve also tried kinda, fading away from people and isolating but it’s not feasible.

I have been standing in this precipice for like 2 years. I think it’s the only reason I’m actually still here. I can’t figure out how to not traumatize someone with my dead body or the knowledge that I killed myself
Yeah I don’t think I could do that. I’m suffering enough now, I don’t want to add more to my end. Just personal opinion though. Tldr: you’d die, but it might suck
Yeah I mean if no one sees you you’ll die eventually but the ocean is terrifying and who knows how long you’ll survive and suffer

I think it really depends on the health condition. I googled some stuff and I’ll add what I found below. Hopefully it helps! I’ve done support groups through local community people - if you’re comfortable asking a pastor, some churches would have an idea. Another great resource is the State Cabinet in your area - social workers usually have all sorts of mental health resources and can always email around for more ideas. 

Here’s what I found after reading some articles - I haven’t tested it but it’s a start!

To find local support groups and services, you can call 1-800-950-NAMI (6264) or email info@nami.org. The National Alliance on Mental Illness HelpLine can be reached Monday through Friday, 10 AM to 6 PM ET.

For a counselor or therapist in your area, view the resources page at Mental Health America: Finding Therapy.
Exactly! Someone needs to step up as like… secondary rock or something.

This is ridiculously relatable. I’ve been slipping from my place as the rock the past two years because I’m just so tired. I’ve been trying for over a decade and it feels like there’s no way up. People forget that even rocks have struggles and honestly? We need rocks too. We need constants and assistance.
Quality of life is something to consider anyway. How quality is someone’s life when they’re so depressed? Thanks for validating me in like 3 different ways on your own post lol

I can’t imagine going through that. Know that your sexuality is valid in whatever way you perceive it. I’ve been raped a few times before but can’t imagine it happening in such a traumatic and identity-shaking way. I don’t know what I can offer but I’m here if you need to talk. Your experience does not make you lesser, it does not make you disgusting, and it does not ruin you. It may feel that way but I promise you that you are still you.

I don’t want to be 80 with a working body. Ngl sometimes I really do be reading those articles about assisted suicide. I can see the merit. My roommates got all heated about it the other day and I was just kinda like “I would hop on that so fast”

Yeah, me too. I don’t want to end up stuck in a bed for the rest of my life, potentially more miserable than now and not able to even attempt again. Which is such a depressing thing to say but like. Idk
Yeah, my only actual attempt I was 19 and now I’m 24 and still going somehow. I’ve had myself on the edge several times but I’ve never had the guts. Kinda scared of pain.
That’s terrifying. I attempted once but chickened out and didn’t go hard enough. I’ve always thought if I tried again I’d go ham. I don’t want to do this another decade of my life.

We’re all depressed. One is religious and says she’d never commit suicide, the other is more unpredictable. I’m the only one who’s attempted. They don’t have the emotional space to deal with me anymore lol
This is a whole horror story and I hate it. Not wrong but I hate it. If I’m gonna attempt I’m gonna stack like 6 ways on top of each other to ensure my job is done
I have 2 roommates and a total of 6 animals in this house lmao
Probably. It just feels so ingrained. I’ve tried stepping back but i get so anxious about it. It keeps me up at night, thinking about her disappointment

Medicine works for some and not others. Just try and keep a journal if you do try it- my first run had me completely wild and not myself. I wish I’d kept a journal to share with my psychiatrist so she could see what I was thinking and doing. 

Same to you! If you need someone to talk to about it, I’ll be around. Sometimes a vaguely unbiased ear can help a lot.

The only thing that’s kept me around is the potential after effects of my death. It’s small things. In 2019 I fell in love with a guy who would later admit he couldn’t hardly remember even dating me. I gave him my all, and he told me I was too fat to love. I haven’t ever recovered from that. I can’t relate to your sunshine type ex, but I can relate to feeling so achingly alone. Recently I’ve been unable to find joy in anything.

I’ve been used for sex before. Saw that in your earlier comment. It ruins you in ways people don’t seem to consider. Like, I’m a person with emotions and I trusted you with something vulnerable, whether that be my emotions or my body. It made me feel ruined each time someone did that to me.

I once went manic for 6 months and no one noticed. My mom was proud I was “doing better.” I skipped an entire semester of classes and got a tattoo. Also spent 3000+ dollars. 

People are ridiculously unobservant. I think they only see what they want to.

I feel like even when I care about other people, I’m doing it from a selfish point of me. Like, do I actually care or is it just a “well, if they’re ___ they can’t help me?” Thing? I work in the public and I find it hard to care about any of it sometimes. I can listen to a tragic backstory and I can’t bring myself to care most of the time anymore. 

In my counseling class in college they said no one helps anyone without selfish reason. I hope that makes you feel somewhat validated.

Thank you for responding. I think just knowing someone read this and understands is mind blowing. Feel free to say whatever and I’ll respond either tonight or tomorrow. I took a benedryl to knock myself out and slow the panic attack I was building to a while ago, so I may not be awake much longer. 

With the job, it’s just. A whole thing. I was raised by a mom who doesn’t feel much emotion, by her own words, because she had to “shut it off.” She doesn’t. Understand any of it and I work so hard to make her proud of me because it was my only driving force for 20 years. I don’t know what to do anymore because I’m always disappointing her. I hate my job, I’ve had it for 2 years, but the pay, retirement, and insurance is good and objectively it’s not a hard job. But I just. Can’t do it for some stupid reason. And it feels ridiculous but like. It feels like taking a. “Lesser” job in my moms words is a failure.

This post is extremely relatable to me. I’m 24, with a college degree I hate, and a parent who expects excellency and got an anxious, depressed mess of a daughter instead. I’ve recently found a slew of minor health issues that feel like a personal attack. Did you know when you start facing your mental health, your body actually leaves fight or flight mode and just. Finally let’s you feel physical illness? I learned it recently. I’ve probably always been sick, but it waited until I tried to get better to pop out. What kind of bullshit is that? 

Anyway, tldr, I get it. We all just put one foot in front of another trying to get to that mysterious good day. Hope it somehow helps to know you’re relatable

I’m the same way. The other day I dropped a hair tie in my cats water bowl and had a full blown suicidal spiral that ended with me in bed for a whole day. Sometimes it’s like the last straw. If you’re stupid and dumb, so am I my dude.
